newsitem.title: USA: Tech stocks seen boosted by Clinton re-election.
newsitem.headline: Tech stocks seen boosted by Clinton re-election.

text.p: Technology shares will be a much better bet than healthcare stocks if U.S. President Bill Clinton is re-elected, according to results from a survey of independent money managers.

The survey of 70 money managers, conducted by Smith Barney Consulting Group between October 2 and October 14, which asked which industry sectors would be most positively affected by Clinton's re-election received more positive mentions in favor of the high technology shares.
According to the survey, the technology sector was mentioned by about 25 percent of managers with financial services mentioned by about 14 percent.
The survey also found that 46 percent of managers believe that healthcare will suffer the most from a Clinton re-election while 27 percent said tobacco stocks would be hurt.
